name: youthful_valkyrie_two_angels_at_once_two_counters
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever another Angel you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' Support card: FDN Raise the Past (verified; 'Return all creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.'). Two Angel cards and a Bear card return to seat 0's battlefield at the same time: each Angel is another Angel entering, so the Valkyrie triggers twice (once per Angel, not once for the event; the Bear is not an Angel): two +1/+1 counters, 3/5.
